mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT choice_text FROM tbl_problem_choices WHERE problem_id = p.problem_id AND is_correct = 1 LIMIT 1) AS answer FROM tbl_problems p WHERE p.problem_id = #{problemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_problem_discussions (problem_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW());
